tournament.name: Pro Tour Competitor Second Chance PTQ

decks.notes: This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive plays, aiming to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The key concept revolves around using efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, Seasoned Pyromancer, and Dauthi Voidwalker to apply constant pressure. The deck also utilizes disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Grief to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Feign Death and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide additional value by triggering ETB effects multiple times. The deck includes a mix of removal spells like Terminate and Lightning Bolt to deal with threats. Additionally, it incorporates a land package to ensure consistent mana access.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of powerful control spells and versatile creatures. By utilizing cards like Solitude, Prismatic Ending, and Leyline Binding to deal with threats, along with Teferi, Time Raveler for disruption, the deck aims to create a stable board state while generating card advantage through cards like Wrenn and Six. The key win condition is to use Omnath, Locus of Creation and The One Ring to generate value and close out the game. The mana base is designed to support the deck's four-color strategy efficiently.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's plays through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and disruptive permanents. By using powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six, along with versatile cards like Solitude and Prismatic Ending, the deck aims to maintain board control and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The inclusion of Omnath, Locus of Creation adds a powerful threat that can quickly close out the game if left unchecked. Kaheera, the Orphanguard provides an additional support creature and synergizes well with the deck's overall game plan.

The main concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to aggressively disrupt the opponent's hand and board with cards like Thoughtseize and Grief, while also applying pressure with efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker. The deck aims to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan while dealing damage quickly to end the game before the opponent can stabilize. The inclusion of removal spells like Terminate and Lightning Bolt helps to maintain control on the board, while cards like Seasoned Pyromancer and Orcish Bowmasters provide additional threats and value. The deck also includes some graveyard interaction with Feign Death and Undying Malice to further disrupt the opponent's plans.

The deck focuses on quickly cycling through cards to fill up the graveyard, then casting Living End to bring back a large number of creatures from the graveyard all at once. This allows the player to overwhelm their opponent with a powerful board presence. The inclusion of cards like Architects of Will and Grief help disrupt the opponent's game plan, while cards like Brazen Borrower provide additional utility. The goal is to efficiently set up the combo and unleash a deadly wave of creatures to finish off the opponent.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on utilizing disruptive creatures like Dauthi Voidwalker and Grief to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while also applying pressure with fast and efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Orcish Bowmasters. The deck also utilizes cards like Feign Death and Undying Malice to protect its threats and make efficient trades in combat. Additionally, the deck includes spells like Thoughtseize and Fury to further disrupt the opponent's hand and board. The overall strategy is to apply early pressure, disrupt the opponent's game plan, and close out the game quickly.

The deck aims to control the game by using counterspells, removal, and land ramp, while setting up for a game-winning Scapeshift combo. Wrenn and Six provide value and card advantage, while Leyline Binding and Wish offer flexibility and disruption. The main win condition is to use Scapeshift to search for Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and a high number of Mountains to deal massive damage to the opponent. The deck also includes land ramp creatures like Arboreal Grazer and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove to accelerate towards the combo.

The main concept of this UR Aggro deck is to apply early pressure with small, efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler. By disrupting the opponent's game plan with countermagic like Counterspell and Force of Negation, along with removal spells such as Unholy Heat and Lightning Bolt, the deck aims to control the board while steadily reducing the opponent's life total. The inclusion of card draw and selection spells like Consider and Expressive Iteration helps maintain card advantage and ensure the deck can continue to apply pressure throughout the game.

The deck focuses on using Underworld Breach to loop through cards in the graveyard, generating value and potentially winning the game with a combo finish. Cards like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Mishra's Bauble help to fill the graveyard, while Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grinding Station provide additional synergy and value. The goal is to assemble the combo pieces while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Lightning Bolt and Teferi, Time Raveler. The deck aims to be fast and efficient, utilizing the graveyard as a resource to achieve victory.

The key concept of this deck is to aggressively and quickly deal damage to the opponent. It utilizes a combination of burn spells and efficient creatures to overwhelm the opponent's life total. The deck focuses on dealing efficient, direct damage through cards like Lightning Bolt, Lava Spike, and Rift Bolt. It also includes cards like Skullcrack and Boros Charm to prevent the opponent from gaining life or disrupting the deck's strategy. The deck's mana base includes a mix of fetchlands and shocklands to ensure consistent access to red mana.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping out powerful cascade spells like Violent Outburst and Ardent Plea to overwhelm the opponent with fast, efficient creatures and disruptive spells. By utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Lórien Revealed, the deck aims to generate card advantage and tempo advantage, outpacing the opponent and creating an aggressive board presence. The deck also includes counterspells like Force of Negation to protect its game plan and control the opponent's plays. Overall, the deck aims to cascade into powerful spells and creatures while maintaining control of the game.

This deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and utilizing cascade mechanics to generate value and tempo advantage. By consistently cascading into powerful spells like Crashing Footfalls and Violent Outburst, the deck can quickly flood the board with threats and pressure the opponent. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Negation and Mystical Dispute to protect its game plan and control the opponent's actions. Overall, the deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent with a combination of speed, aggression, and card advantage.

The main concept of the Rakdos Aggro deck is to aggressively control the board by playing efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Grief. The deck also utilizes removal spells like Terminate and Fatal Push to deal with threats, as well as combat tricks like Undying Malice and Feign Death to surprise the opponent. The deck aims to apply consistent pressure and disrupt the opponent's strategy in order to secure a quick victory.

The main concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to put pressure on the opponent quickly with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker, backed up by disruptive cards like Grief and Thoughtseize. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells like Terminate and Fatal Push while using cards like Seasoned Pyromancer to generate card advantage. Feign Death and Undying Malice provide synergy with creature cards, helping to maintain a strong board presence and overwhelm the opponent efficiently in a 1 vs 1 match.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on playing aggressively with efficiently costed threats like Murktide Regent, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer. It aims to outpace opponents by disrupting their game plan with counterspells like Spell Pierce and Counterspell, while also clearing the way with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat. The deck also has card filtering and advantage with cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration. The mana base is optimized for consistency and speed, allowing the deck to quickly close out games.

This deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Tower, Urza's Mine, Urza's Power Plant) to quickly generate large amounts of mana. It utilizes powerful control elements such as Karn, the Great Creator and Oblivion Stone to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also includes powerful win conditions like Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger and Wurmcoil Engine to quickly close out games once control has been established. The main goal is to efficiently ramp into powerful threats while disrupting the opponent's game plan.
